# CoinMarketCal
> The economic calendar for cryptocurrency events: verified sources, impacted coins, dates, impact scoring, and API access.

## Primary resources
- [Developer API](https://coinmarketcal.com/developer): API access to curated crypto event data.
- [API documentation](https://coinmarketcal.com/developer/docs): Endpoints, authentication, pagination, webhooks, and OpenAPI.
- [MCP server](https://coinmarketcal.com/developer/docs/mcp): Model Context Protocol access for AI agents using the same x-api-key as the REST API.

## Key facts
- CoinMarketCal has tracked cryptocurrency events since 2017.
- Coverage includes project events from official channels and exchange listing pages, plus major crypto conferences from Luma's major events, checked on official sites.
- A conference links the coins whose teams are represented by speakers, and can link none.
- Event pages include source URLs, proof screenshots, affected coins, and impact summaries when available.
- Estimated dates are marked separately from confirmed dates.
- The API is designed for trading tools, newsletters, dashboards, bots, and research workflows.
- AI agents can call the calendar over MCP at https://coinmarketcal.com/mcp with an x-api-key header; tools proxy GET /v2 and share quota with the REST API.
